title: pvEllipse
body:
## pvEllipse

Creates an elliptical arc or full ellipse as a polyline: centred at Center, in the plane normal to Normal, with major radius given by the length of MajorRadiusVector and minor radius Ratio × major. StartAngle and SectorAngle (degrees, measured from the major axis) select part of the perimeter, and Close joins the ends. Use it for annotation, seed curves or circular probes (Ratio 1 gives a circle).

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- MajorRadiusVector must not be parallel to Normal; VTK then reports an error and produces nothing.
- Schemaxis generates this source from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for it, so inspect the output before relying on it.

Native constructor: `Ellipse`. Identity: `sources/EllipseSource`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Center` | The center of the ellipse. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Close` | When on, closes the elliptical arc by adding a line segment between the last point and the first point. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MajorRadiusVector` | The origin of polar angle and the major radius size. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Normal` | The normal of the plane containing the ellipse. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Ratio` | Ratio of the ellipse defined as minor radius / major radius. Valid values are in the range [0.001, 1.0]. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.001,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.001` |
| `Resolution` | Number of line segments in the polyline defining the ellipse edge. | `{"maximum":1024,"minimum":8,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `8` |
| `SectorAngle` | The angular sector occupied by the arc, measured in degrees from the **Start Angle**. | `{"maximum":360.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `StartAngle` | The angle (in degrees) where the ellipse begins relative to the **Major Radius Vector**. | `{"maximum":360.0,"minimum":-360.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `-360.0` |
